measures.titleOnList: Measure AB: Sonoma County Junior College District Bond

ballotQuestion.text: Without increasing tax rates, to improve facilities to train students for careers in nursing/firefighting/first responders, building trades, agriculture, auto mechanics; attract/retain high quality faculty, prepare students for universities; repair leaky roofs; repair, construct, and acquire classrooms/sites/facilities/equipment, shall the Sonoma County Junior College District measure be adopted authorizing $830,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $25 per $100,000 of assessed valuation ($55,300,000 annually), while bonds are outstanding, and with oversight/audits/local control?
ballotQuestion.location: Sonoma County 049M501 9311 (page code of first page; exact page of question not confirmed)

measureType.evidence: authorize the sale of up to $830,000,000 in general obligation bonds.

threshold.evidence: if 55% of the voters who vote on the measure approve the sale of the bonds. Also heading "55% Needed to Pass".

fiscal.text: Tax Rate Statement. "authorize the sale of up to $830,000,000 in general obligation bonds." Average rate "is $22.00 per $100,000 (2.2¢ per $100) of assessed valuation." Highest rate "is $25.00 per $100,000 (2.5¢ per $100) of assessed valuation first occurring in fiscal year 2041-42." "It is currently anticipated that the tax will be collected until fiscal year 2058-59." Both readings matched.

measures.plainEnglish: Authorizes the Sonoma County Junior College District to issue $830,000,000 in bonds for facilities, levying $25 per $100,000 of assessed valuation while bonds are outstanding. The question says this is without increasing tax rates.
